description_en: Queries the mount information of KVCacheInstance resources in batches
description_zh: 批量查询 KVCacheInstance 挂载信息
name: ListKVCacheStoreAttachInfo

parameters.help_en: The region ID, such as cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of KVCacheStore KvcsId values to query. A maximum of 100 values can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的 KVCacheStore KvcsId 列表，最多 100 个
parameters.name: kvcs_ids

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return in a single request. Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
查询时单次的最大条目数。取值范围：1~500

默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request. If you set NextToken, the PageSize and PageNumber request parameters become ineffective, and the TotalCount value in the response is invalid
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。如果设置了NextToken，则请求参数PageSize和PageNumber将失效，且返回数据中的TotalCount无效
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. Used together with PageSize. If the value exceeds the total number of pages, the last page of data is returned
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时的页码。配合PageSize使用，超出总数时会返回最后一页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数
parameters.name: page_size
